Crime & Law · World

Multiple fatal road accidents reported across India and globally

Multiple road accidents have resulted in fatalities and injuries across India and internationally. In India, a conductor was killed and passengers injured when a bus overturned in Bengal. A woman died in Delhi after being run over by a bus, leading to a road blockade by her family. In Kerala, a woman was killed when a KSRTC bus veered off the road, with locals suggesting the driver had a medical emergency. Another KSRTC bus plunged into a ghat road in Palakkad, killing one and injuring several. In Rajasthan, a crash between a tourist vehicle and a trailer killed three and injured 15. Internationally, a bus overturned in Algeria, killing at least 25 people, and in Uganda, a bus crash killed 20 children. Another accident in Uganda involving a passenger van and a sand truck killed 14.
